data.name: Akib
data.gender_notes: Akib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Akib refers to the successor or heir, one who follows and continues the legacy of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) or a righteous leader. In the Quran, Akib is mentioned as a name of one of the martyrs of the Battle of Uhud. The name Akib carries the meaning “Successor, Heir” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akib usually hope their child will grow to embody successor, heir and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to strive for success in this life and the hereafter, to be a worthy successor of our faith and values.
data.etymology: Akib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Successor, Heir.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akib total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عقيب
in_arabic.meaning: عقيب يعني الذي يأتي بعد أو يتبع في المعنى
in_arabic.long_meaning: عقيب هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عقب' والذي يعني المتابعة أو الإتباع. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يأتي بعد أو يتبع نهج السابقين. له أهمية في التراث العربي والإسلامي كدلالة على الاستمرارية والتواصل بين الأجيال.

in_urdu.name: عقیب
in_urdu.meaning: عقیب کا مطلب ہے جو شخص بعد میں آتا ہے یا کسی کے نقش قدم پر چلتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عقیب ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کسی کے بعد آنے والا یا کسی کے طریقے کو اپنانے والا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نسل انسانی کی تسلسل اور روحانی رہنمائی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अकीब
in_hindi.meaning: अकीब का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति किसी के बाद आता है या उसके नक्शे कदम पर चलता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अकीब एक ऐसा नाम है जो अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और जिसका अर्थ है किसी के बाद आने वाला या किसी के तरीके को अपनाने वाला। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पीढ़ियों के बीच आध्यात्मिक संबंध और निरंतरता का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عقیب
in_pashto.meaning: عقیب دى هغه کسانو لپاره چې وروسته راځي یا د بل چا په نقشه چلې
in_pashto.long_meaning: عقیب د پښتو کلتور او ژبې يو نوم دى چې مطلب يې دى دى هغه څوک چې وروسته راځي یا د مخکيني کس په طرز چلې. دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتونستان په سیمه کې دود دی او د اسلامي ارزښتونو د تسلسل نښه ګڼل کېږي.

in_english.name: Akib
in_english.meaning: Akib means someone who comes after or follows in the footsteps of another
in_english.long_meaning: The name Akib originates from the Arabic root 'aqaba', meaning to follow or come after. In Islamic tradition, Akib signifies a person who follows the path of others, often implying a sense of continuity and spiritual succession. Historically, this name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote respect for predecessors and the continuation of their legacies.

data.cultural_impact: The name Akib holds a significant cultural impact as it is associated with the idea of continuity and legacy. In the Islamic world, a leader or a community can pass on their teachings, traditions, and values to the next generation through the person of an Akib. This concept reinforces the importance of passing on the rich Islamic heritage to future generations and preserving the collective memory of the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Akib holds a deep meaning as it relates to the concept of following in the footsteps of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and other righteous leaders. It is a reminder of the importance of emulating the virtuous qualities and actions of those who have gone before us, and striving to live up to their example in our own lives. The spiritual significance of the name encourages individuals to be faithful to their faith and to seek guidance from those who are knowledgeable and pious. By acting as an Akib, one can contribute to the ongoing legacy of the Islamic community and help to strengthen the bonds of faith and unity among its members.

historical_references.reference: The name Akib is mentioned in the poetic works of Imam Rummi, a famous Sufi poet from the 13th century, in his Masnavi. In this context, Akib is used as a symbol of the soul in its spiritual journey towards the Divine, and is often mentioned in relation to the character of 'Khidr' - a wise, mystical figure from Islamic tradition.
